title: Microstructure modelling using enhanced diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging for non-invasive prostate cancer diagnostics - a feasibility study
summary: In recent years, new, promising approaches have emerged in the field of MRI imaging of the prostate. These approaches are mostly aimed at visualizing the so-called 'microstructures' of the tissue and are intended to offer greater accuracy in the diagnosis of prostate cancer than the current mpMRI examination. For this purpose, mathematical microstructure models are calculated, which calculate the proportional presence of histological substructures in certain MRI volumes. To calculate the microstructure models, additional new MRI sequences are required, which are not routinely acquired. To further investigate the possibilities of these new MRI sequences, a comparison of different mathematical models will be performed in this study.

interventions.name: For men with suspected prostate cancer and an indication for an MRI, additional MRI sequences are included in the standard protocol. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- patients are scheduled for an mpMRI examination due to suspected prostate carcinoma
Exclusion criteria:
- patients have a contraindication for an MRI scan AND
- patients have had previous radiotherapy of the prostate, hormone therapy, previous TUR-P or other prostate surgery AND 
- patients lack willingness, ability and capacity to consent
